nodes.label: Video Studio Project Inventory
nodes.rationale: Read-only survey (2026-07-16) of autoVSL dashboard (port 5170, migration base), subtitle-studio (port 5180, best erase engine), dubbing-studio (7860, XTTS/Wav2Lip); key insight: the unified app was ~80% already built inside autoVSL/dashboard; 8 of 11 required modules already existed, only DubSync Repair was net-new.

nodes.label: ProPainter Video Inpainting Engine
nodes.rationale: The quality subtitle-erase path (tools/ProPainter): AI video inpaint on GPU, auto caption-band detection (EasyOCR/CRAFT), 720-frame chunks, fp16, persistent resume cache — the resumability model Video Studio generalizes.

nodes.label: faster-whisper Transcription Engine
nodes.rationale: distil-large-v3 with word timestamps cached in words.json (course_pipeline/.venv); powers transcription, editable lines.json, and word-timed ASS caption burning.

nodes.label: Coqui XTTS v2 Voice Clone Engine
nodes.rationale: Local free voice clone + synthesis (17 languages), time-stretched to video length pitch-preserved, normalized to -16 LUFS; from dubbing-studio.

nodes.label: Wav2Lip Lip-Sync Engine
nodes.rationale: Local Wav2Lip GAN + GFPGAN v1.4 or CodeFormer face restore (weights in tools/Wav2Lip and CodeFormer/); the local lip-sync chain behind dubbing and DubSync Repair.

nodes.label: fal.ai Cloud Generation Service
nodes.rationale: Paid cloud path for video generation (seedance/wan/hailuo/kling) and voice-clone/lip-sync (f5-tts, LatentSync); FAL_KEY lives only in autoVSL/.env, injected into subprocess env — single secret location.

nodes.label: ComfyUI Local Generation Service
nodes.rationale: Local free GPU image/video generation at 127.0.0.1:8188 (SD 1.5, Real-ESRGAN, ControlNet); the $0 alternative to fal.ai.

nodes.label: Claude CLI Local AI
nodes.rationale: ~/.local/bin/claude.exe used as free local AI for VSL building, copywriting/rewrite, caption spell-fix, and vision-based QC review — runs on the Claude subscription, no API cost.

nodes.label: VSR Magic Erase Tool (video-subtitle-remover)
nodes.rationale: tools/vsr: STTN-based inpainting subtitle remover (~5 fps), the 'magic erase' alternative engine invoked by subtitle-studio.
